name: tourision
description: Explore 360-degree virtual tours of real places, such as hotels, properties, museums and showrooms, inside the conversation.

interface.longDescription:
Tourision lets you explore immersive 360-degree virtual tours of real places, such as hotels and resorts, homes for sale, offices, schools, museums, showrooms and stores, right inside the conversation.

Ask for a tour in any language, by place name, city or simply a category such as "a hotel", and Tourision finds matching tours and opens the best one in an interactive viewer. You can look around by dragging, zoom in and out, switch between rooms with the scene strip and go fullscreen.

What it can do:
- Search publicly published virtual tours by name, address, description or category.
- Open a tour in an embedded, interactive 360-degree viewer, with a link to open the full tour in a new tab.
- Always show at least one tour: if nothing matches exactly, featured tours are suggested.

Who it is for:
- Travellers checking a hotel before booking.
- People looking at a home, office, school or venue remotely.
- Anyone who wants to see what a place looks like inside before visiting.

Limitations:
- The app is read-only. It cannot create, edit or delete tours.
- Only tours that their owners have published publicly on Tourision are available. Draft and archived tours are never returned.
- No account or sign-in is needed, and the app does not ask for or store any personal information.
capabilities: Search 360-degree virtual tours in any language
Show an interactive 360-degree tour in chat
Answer questions about Tourision with a sample tour
defaultPrompt: Show me The Aura Hotel in 360°
Show me a garden furniture showroom virtual tour
Show me a prefabricated house factory virtual tour

positive.description: Named hotel (starter prompt 1). search_tours finds the tour by name and directly displays it in the embedded viewer.
positive.prompt: Show me The Aura Hotel in 360°
positive.expected_behavior: search_tours returns The Aura Hotel first and the widget immediately shows it with a header (tour name, Open full tour, Fullscreen) and the interactive tour with a scene strip.

positive.description: Generic request for a hotel tour. search_tours finds hotel tours and directly displays the best match.
positive.prompt: Show me a 360° virtual tour of a hotel
positive.expected_behavior: search_tours returns hotel tours with Taj Exotica Resort & Spa, The Palm, Dubai first, and the widget shows it.

positive.prompt: Show me a garden furniture showroom virtual tour
positive.expected_behavior: search_tours returns showroom tours and the widget shows Casso Home Garden Showroom (Ankara) with its floor filter and scene strip.

positive.prompt: Show me a prefabricated house factory virtual tour
positive.expected_behavior: search_tours returns factory tours and the widget shows Nuris Prefabrik (Ankara) with an aerial 360° view and scene strip.

positive.description: Non-English request (Turkish): "Show me a hotel virtual tour". Queries in any language are supported.
positive.prompt: Bana bir otel sanal turu göster
positive.expected_behavior: search_tours returns hotel tours and the widget shows Taj Exotica Resort & Spa, The Palm, Dubai, with viewer labels in Turkish.

about_tourision returns a short description of Tourision (features, who uses it, how to get a tour) and the widget shows a sample tour (Taj Exotica Resort & Spa, The Palm, Dubai) so the user can try it immediately.

positive.description: Opening a specific tour by its identifier (slug).
positive.prompt: Open the Tourision tour with the slug the-aura-hotel
positive.expected_behavior: get_tour is called with slug "the-aura-hotel" and the widget shows The Aura Hotel tour. If a slug does not exist, a featured tour is shown instead of an error.

negative.description: Unrelated request about the weather. The app should not be used.
negative.prompt: What is the weather like in Istanbul tomorrow?

negative.description: Unrelated request for a currency conversion. The app should not be used.
negative.prompt: Convert 100 US dollars to Turkish lira

negative.description: Unrelated creative writing request. The app should not be used.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only searches and displays publicly published virtual tours.

publication.release_notes: New about_tourision tool: questions about Tourision (in any language) are answered with a sample tour shown directly in chat. Search in any language, category-aware results (hotel, home, school, office, store...), the best match opens directly in the viewer, featured tours when nothing matches, viewer labels in the user's language, and directory screenshots.
